Q-6053: Days from 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12 (count end, not start)

Answer: 364 days

Calculation: From 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-13 is exactly 365 days (2021 is not a leap year, Feb has 28 days). We need to 2021-12-12, which is one day less = 364 days.
